prompt: Identify clearly visible construction hazards in one short sentence. If none are clear, say so. Do not infer movement or hidden hazards.
pipeline: nvarguscamerasrc sensor-id=0 ! video/x-raw(memory:NVMM),width=1280,height=720,framerate=30/1,format=NV12 ! nvvidconv ! video/x-raw,width=640,height=360,format=BGRx ! videoconvert ! video/x-raw,format=BGR ! appsink drop=true max-buffers=1 sync=false
design: Periodic live image analysis, not verified temporal event detection
timestamp_definition: Host monotonic and UTC immediately after camera.read; not sensor exposure time
timing_definition: Inference includes query image encoding and decoding; frame age includes frame saving/preparation; completion excludes result disk write

short32.prompt: Identify clearly visible construction hazards in one short sentence. If none are clear, say so. Do not infer movement or hidden hazards.

compact16.prompt: Name the clearest visible construction hazard in at most six words. If unclear, say 'none clear'. Do not infer motion or hidden hazards.

cache_design: Existing per-image EncodedImage prefix reused for two serial queries; discarded before selecting next image. No cross-frame cache.
comparison_warning: Two-prompt benchmarking reduces update rate. Standalone-equivalent = shared encoding + own query; this estimate excludes the other prompt, not actual wall delay. Capture-to-answer is measured actual wall delay.
